description: The photograph depicts an open, slightly rolling landscape primarily covered by dense, low-growing green shrubs and bushes, consistent with heathland or scrub vegetation. Patches of lighter brown ground, possibly dry grass or bare earth, are visible between the green vegetation. In the foreground, darker areas of detritus or low, sparse vegetation are present, suggesting a rugged or rocky surface. A few small trees are visible on the left side. In the far distance, several vertical structures, resembling wind turbines or power line pylons, are silhouetted against a light blue sky with scattered clouds. The scene suggests a secondary ecosystem with unfavourable natural conditions, as described by the surrounding context for areas dominated by brush, bushes, and herbaceous vegetation where the field layer has >50% cover and tree cover <10%.
